user.title: Calendar Card with Avatars
user.description: Adds the Calendar Card with Avatars to your dashboards: a seven-day agenda with people's pictures in front of their events. After this, edit a dashboard, choose Add card and pick Calendar Card with Avatars.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Calendar Card with Avatars is already set up.

create_entry.default: Done. Reload this page once (press F5, pull down on a phone or tablet, or restart a kiosk app) so your browser loads the card. Then edit a dashboard, choose Add card and pick Calendar Card with Avatars.
